unmapped_events_and_recommendations.xdg_description_en: The sound used when a phone/voip call is ended due to hangup.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.reason_unmapped_en: Left unmapped (inherits from freedesktop): none of the 4 archives contain a clean call-disconnect click/drop tone, and using farewell voice lines ('Mata', 'Shūryō') after every voice call feels awkward.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.recommendation_en: Use the default freedesktop phone-hangup tone or a soft 2-note descending 425Hz -> 300Hz sine drop (180ms).

unmapped_events_and_recommendations.xdg_description_en: The sound used when a phone/voip call is canceled due to some error.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.reason_unmapped_en: Left unmapped (inherits from freedesktop): no distinct telephony reorder/SIT error tone exists in the archives.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.recommendation_en: Allow fallback to freedesktop or use a standard 3-tone SIT (Special Information Tone) sequence.

unmapped_events_and_recommendations.xdg_description_en: The sound used when the battery is fully loaded up.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.reason_unmapped_en: Left unmapped (inherits from freedesktop): no voice clip specifically refers to charging/power completion, and reusing generic 'Kanryō' would confuse users into thinking a download finished while their laptop is plugged in.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.recommendation_en: Keep unmapped or use a soft 2-note warm chime (or a custom TTS clip saying 'Jūden kanryō').

unmapped_events_and_recommendations.xdg_description_en: The power cable has been unplugged.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.reason_unmapped_en: Left unmapped (inherits from freedesktop): distinct from 'power-unplug-battery-low' and 'device-removed'; no separate dedicated AC-unplug tone in the archives without duplicating 'device-removed'.
unmapped_events_and_recommendations.recommendation_en: Allow fallback to freedesktop's power-unplug or link to a subtle 200ms low-pass descending two-tone.

unmapped_events_and_recommendations.xdg_description_en: The lid has been opened (for laptops, mobile devices).

unmapped_events_and_recommendations.xdg_description_en: A countdown (e.g. for a photo shooting) sound that is repeated each second.
